title: Old Mosul & Drive to Erbil
full_text:
8 AM Start the day with discovering the reconstruction of the old city, especially Al-Nuri Mosque, Al Hadbaa Minaret and Al Tahira church that are being rebuilt by UNESCO.
Walk through the area where the last and most intensive battle against ISIS took place.
Hear stories from the individuals who lived through the war.
The famous "Kubba of Mosul" for lunch — a delicious dish made by locals.
After that, we will drive to Erbil.
We will have a tour in Erbil and head to the citadel to see the bustling markets there, and explore the bazaar around it.
internal_notes: MO1 with the drive to Erbil, so a trip through the plains can leave the region. Sold as this day in '7 Days Tour - John Request' and 'Private Tour - John Kodenkandeth'. Its region is an exception: it sleeps in Erbil and is the only exit Western Iraq & Nineveh Plains has (ws-03 phase seven, WP35.3, WP36.2). MO1 and MO1EB are an alternative pair.
